trials.reviewer: Coordinator (Claude Code): viewed all five fixed views and reviewed every check against measured files; not an independent sign-off; same file, views and scores as the v1 baseline, joint-range re-measured with the r2 contract

design-intent.reason: Brown spiky hair, anime face, silver plate, blue coat with white tabard, leather gloves, belt and boots and a straight sword are all present; armor patches painted on the cloth core clash with the separate cuirass.

silhouette.reason: Front and three-quarter read clearly; side and back are stable, but the right wrist fitting is bulbous and the pauldrons sit detached from the arm line.

form-proportion.reason: Main volumes hold at rest, but the left hand has mitten-like fused finger segments, the right wrist sleeve balloons and duplicated armor volume remains on the core.

materials.reason: Material regions are readable in all five views; seams and the duplicated painted armor on the core remain.

craft.reason: Several critical defects under the contract poses: shoulder flexion collapses triangles and drives the arm through the cuirass, elbow and hip fold, and the exposed right hand self-intersects at typical angles.

use-readability.reason: None of the required skill combo, locomotion, sleep or cast clips exists; only a 61-frame grip prototype.

art_match.method: Viewed the five fixed views of this exact file: character reads correctly, but painted armor patches on the cloth core overlap the cuirass, the right wrist fitting is bulbous and the grasp is a prototype.

scale_pivot.method: Read-only Blender inventory: core height 1.74 m, armature and meshes at world origin with unit scale; GLB accessor bounds Y 0..1.74 with +Y up. Scope: size, axis and ground pivot only.

geometry_materials.method: 57,039 triangles measured (budget 60,000) and 2K textures present, but every mesh has open boundary edges of undiagnosed cause, armor and core overlap visibly, and the right hand is a different source than the r010 hand.

package_complete.method: Only the baseline BLEND and GLB exist; no clips, interaction data, QA scene package, README or manifest for this request.

rig_mapping.method: 53 bones: right thumb has 2 segments, left fingers 2 segments each, no control layer. Five contract motions cannot be posed because the bones are missing, and no grasp pose asset exists.

deformation.method: Joint-range sweep on this file with the r2 contract: 35 of 73 motions fail or cannot be posed.

animation.method: Only the 61-frame wrist-grip prototype action exists; none of the nine listed clips is present.

skill-effects.method: No slash, fire or golden effect objects exist in the inspected file.
